manual_inspection.endpoint_method: Fresh capture of every declared case/state/profile from unmodified emitted chapters. All 28 paused in-flight full PNGs manually inspected. Actual WAAPI times, retained committed index, paused/moving state and exact finished endpoint are bound in each sample. Repeated sequence writes/reveals/transforms, pool copy, and plot/register execution are grouped; this does not claim every transition or instant.
